notes.thresholdPct: Alert when |ETF price vs iNAV premium| >= this percent. Per-symbol override in etfOverrides, else defaultThresholdPct.
notes.gramsPerUnit: Approximate metal grams per ETF unit, used only for India-vs-global landed price comparison. Drifts over time due to expenses.
notes.fundingAlertDailyPct: Alert when Binance perp funding exceeds this percent per day (cost of holding the hedge).
notes.importDutyPct: Customs duty on gold/silver imports. Update if budget changes it.
notes.secret: Required as ?secret= to trigger alert sending. Reads are open.
notes.pickerBands: Buy-picker timing bands per metal, judged on the CHEAPEST live-iNAV premium: <= cheapPct is CHEAP (good add), >= richPct is RICH (avoid adding), else NORMAL.
